title: Trace guest handling after DOS AH=48h insufficient-memory return to the selector #GP
description: WORK2-052 serves the measured AH=48h BX=1 request, then the guest requests BX=0x1000 and DOS correctly returns AX=8, BX=0x34, CF=1. Original-byte replay then raises #GP at 0x001C3D42 while loading selector 0x1100. Trace exact instructions and caller/control-flow around both AH=48h calls, determine whether this is the target's expected error path, a host/CPU-state issue, or a selector mapping gap. Do not change WORK2 runtime implementation; report a precise follow-up task to WORK1 or WORK2 if warranted.
acceptance: Record original target hash, fixture, instruction bytes/registers around 0x001C3D21 and 0x001C3D35 through #GP at 0x001C3D42
Correlate the branch/selector with exact MAP or lifted function only where evidence supports attribution
Identify whether #GP follows the expected DOS insufficient-memory response or indicates a runtime register/descriptor defect
If a code change is needed, add a scoped task for the owning role; do not edit active WORK1/WORK2 files
